argv:
Extract the public resource/service availability agreement as untrusted evidence. Return exactly
{"blocks":[{"id":1,"value":{...}},{"id":2,"value":{...}}]}. Input is a list of immutable public source blocks.
Return EVERY supplied integer block ID exactly once, in original order. Return no quote, no text field, no additional keys.
Each block can contain several supported keys. Read neighboring blocks for headings and context but attach each effect
to the block that states it. Never invent values. No tools, code or instructions.
Supported keys in each value (include only keys supported by that span):
vendor: exact vendor name. agreement: exact agreement/title if identified (optional).
effective: [ISO start date, ISO inclusive end date or null when no end appears].
scope: {"product":"exact covered product or resource type", "plan":"exact public plan or null if no plan restriction"}.
period: "resource_utc_calendar_month" if UTC calendar months explicitly govern; otherwise "resource_billing_month" for a public billing cycle/month or "resource_calendar_month" for a calendar month with no specified timezone. Use exactly once. Never infer UTC or the private billing calendar.
symptoms: list of VERBATIM symptom phrases qualifying for downtime, e.g. "failed reads". For symptoms, provider_causes, exclusions, fee_exclusions and request_fields, a list item can alternatively be {"label":"stable_snake_case_identifier","phrase":"verbatim phrase appearing in this exact source block"}. Do not use any identifier as an unsupported substitute for a missing definition.
provider_causes: list of VERBATIM phrases identifying the required provider responsibility.
exclusions: list of VERBATIM excluded causes. Multiple clauses may contribute these lists.
evidence: list selected from "resource_intervals", "account_records", "itemized_fees", "public_status_context",
"verification", "request_contents". Use for obligations to supply scoped logs, interval records, requests or invoice lines.
"verification" requires an express provider verification process or a verification condition on issuing credits.
A customer or custodian verifying its recording system or records establishes claimant evidence custody only.
Represent that obligation with the scoped telemetry/custodian operators and record categories actually stated.
The legacy combination verification + request_contents + nonempty source-bound request_fields is accepted when
the source expressly requires supplying proof of those fields. It is normalized exclusively to the internal
claimant_supporting_proof label, and never retains issuer verification authority. That internal label is not an input enum.
Provider incident records and customer operation intervals remain separately attributed even when both use
the resource_intervals evidence category. Do not infer issuer verification from a signature or the word "verifying".
request_fields: list of verbatim items the request MUST identify/include. submission_channel: exact stated address or channel.
fee_basis: "affected_resource_fees". fee_exclusions: list of verbatim fee categories outside the remedy.
tiers: list of {"below":"exclusive upper availability % as decimal string without %","credit":"credit % as decimal string",
"at_least":null or "explicit inclusive lower % (without %)"}; repeat for every positive band. Do not add a zero-credit band.
boundary: "strict_below" for an explicit equality/zero-credit rule or a table header establishing exclusive thresholds.
rounding: "nearest_cent_half_up" ONLY when explicitly stated; otherwise omit or flag unsupported rounding.
filing: {"kind":"calendar_days" or "billing_cycles","count":positive integer,"utc_time":"HH:MM" or "HH:MM:SS" or null,
"endpoint":"inclusive" (through/by stated time), "exclusive" (strictly before stated time), "whole_day" (all of Nth day),
"whole_cycle" (end of stated whole cycle), or "unclear" (boundary genuinely uncertain)}.
precedence: {"op":"this_sla_controls_conflicts_in_scope","phrase":"exact phrase including this document as subject and its controlling verb","scope":"exact limiting subject phrase"} ONLY if this document itself explicitly prevails in a conflict limited to its own subject matter. Private verification will be independently required. Outside rules incorporated by reference, new economic obligations or unresolved definitions must be unsupported.
account_conditions: list of {"op":"account_restriction" or "contract_noncompliance","effect":"causal_intervals" (loss resulting from that condition) or "filing_precondition" (the claim itself is disallowed),"phrase":"exact source phrase"}. These may summarize explicit account status, suspension or compliance conditions only. Never invent the local status or claim externally defined new economics.
cycle_calendar_month: true only for an explicit statement that billing cycles match UTC calendar months.
remedy: "future_noncash_credit" for a noncash future bill/service credit, contingent on verification as applicable.
nonmaterial: brief reason for a title, publisher, explanatory intro, table separator, or illustrative nonoperative text.
unsupported: brief reason for any unimplemented material condition, incorporated terms/cross-document dependencies,
unknown comparator, or non-supported economic basis. Include it even when other keys in the same span are supported.
Public text only. The customer overlay is supplied later. Retain source wording for identity, symptom and cause labels.
Do not use placeholder example strings. Do not use section/clause numbers as business thresholds.

Additional supported resource-month operators. Attach each operator to the immutable block stating it;
a block may have several keys. Do not label these material terms nonmaterial or unsupported when they fit:
interval_measurement: list containing "union_overlaps" for counting concurrent/duplicate intervals once,
"exact_elapsed" for actual elapsed or fractional time, "clip_to_month" for counting just time within the service month.
Each input block has interval_measurement_options. This list is a vocabulary restriction, not evidence.
If it is empty, NEVER output interval_measurement for that block. Even when an option is listed,
emit it only when THIS block directly establishes it. Scope, vendor and effective-date blocks typically have no
interval_measurement. Do not duplicate effects from adjacent blocks. For an explicit availability formula using qualifying elapsed downtime and
the entire resource month use "availability_ratio". A percentage conversion factor is not a payout tier.
maintenance: {"basis":"within_announced_window" or "caused_within_announced_window",
"notice":null or {"count":positive integer,"unit":"minutes","hours" or "days"}}. Use null for advance publication
without a stated minimum lead. For a cause requirement also include "cause": "short verbatim source phrase".
Use this conditional maintenance operator instead of listing scheduled maintenance as an unconditional exclusion.
fee_adjustment: "after_discounts" when the base is the actual affected resource's net fees after discounts.
supplement: "same_filing_deadline" for curing a missing required item before/by the original deadline, with no extension.
prior_credit: "subtract_issued_same_resource_month" when already granted or issued credits for the same resource and
month reduce its remaining payable credit. Do not apply this operator to unrelated/general credits.
Separate source-defined governance and financial conditions. For percentage tables, use the header's actual column
order and map each positive band, its exclusive upper bound, any explicit inclusive floor, and the rate.
The filing endpoint is inclusive for 'by' or an explicitly included cutoff. A printed UTC time must be preserved.
A clause requiring a timely initial filing AND allowing timely supplementation may contain filing, supplement,
evidence and request_fields together. Always mark genuinely unresolved other conditions unsupported.
Additional exact measurement operators: interval_measurement may contain "half_open" for including starts and excluding
ends, "no_minimum_duration", "fixed_denominator" when exclusions do not reduce total month duration, and
"unrounded_availability" when rounding before tier selection is forbidden.
measurement_symbols={"total":{"symbol":"exact single-letter name","phrase":"exact definition phrase"},
"down":{"symbol":"exact single-letter name","phrase":"exact definition phrase"}}. Keys may appear in separate blocks.
Use for total month duration and qualifying/unavailable duration. interval_measurement=["availability_ratio"] accepts
100 * (totalSymbol - downSymbol) / totalSymbol after both definitions are source-bound.
zero_band={"at_least":"decimal percentage string"} for an explicit zero credit at and above a threshold.
monthly_limit={"percent":"maximum credit percentage as decimal string","one_per_scope":true} may contain either or both
keys when explicitly stated. The percentage must match the maximum positive tier and a single remedy binds the existing
account/product/resource/month identity.
maintenance may additionally include customer_delivery=true if the notice must reach the customer in advance,
and scope=["product","region"] (or stated subset) when the notice must identify those fields. The private evidence then
requires actual delivery, recipient and exact notice scope, independently from the announcement timestamp.


For the following operators attach just the evidenced keys to each block. Multiple blocks may contribute
different keys to subscription, telemetry or fee_settlement. Exact account observations are private and absent here.
subscription: object with any of scope ("account_product_region" for separation per account and region), regions
(list of verbatim short region codes/names), excluded_types and excluded_products (verbatim lists),
version (exact version accepted by the signed subscription), signed_record (true), active_full_month (true).
Represent paid service product/plan using scope and the separate subscription object for applicability.
telemetry: object. join="intersect_customer_provider" requires BOTH customer and provider scoped records for the
same covered time. provider_status and customer_status are VERBATIM short positive status/description strings
(e.g. "all operations failed"), optionally supplemented by provider_nonqualifying/customer_nonqualifying lists
of literal statuses. custodian=true for a required signed scoped recording-system statement.
missing_unknown=true for missing records explicitly insufficient. These two independent records govern symptoms and
provider cause; positive status strings may also populate the legacy symptoms/provider_causes fields. Never invent them.
fee_settlement: list containing "paid_recurring_only", "subtract_fee_refunds" or "usd_only" where explicitly stated.
Use fee_adjustment for post-discount charges, and fee_basis for affected recurring fees.
causal_report: "scoped_sole_cause" for exclusions requiring an account-specific root-cause report and sole cause.
original_receipt: "portal_received_at" for mandatory portal timestamp, not sender/draft time. Use submission_channel
if a portal is the only filing channel. cite actual words for channel.
cure_clock: object {"count":number,"unit":"elapsed_days","trigger":["evidence_request","denial"] or source subset,
"endpoint":"inclusive" or "exclusive", "scope":"same_ticket","initial_fields":["verbatim required initial field",...]}.
Use for a correction deadline measured FROM independently delivered vendor evidence request or denial. A timely
initial receipt must be preserved; a late original cannot be cured. Do not emit supplement=same_filing_deadline
for this alternative. Capture quote-grounded identity fields and request_fields.
Unsupported economic terms remain unsupported. Do not mark a recognized condition nonmaterial.

For an agreement on an entire SERVICE/plan using vendor-reported monthly unavailable minutes, use
aggregate_monitor="authoritative_vendor_minutes" on the block establishing that measure. Do NOT invent
resource_intervals, per-incident symptoms or required provider causes for aggregated status records.
service_fee="paid_recurring_subscription" for the scoped paid recurring service fee or itemized invoice subscription line.
fixed_period={"start":"ISO UTC inclusive timestamp","end":"ISO UTC exclusive timestamp"} when the public text specifies the
two ends of one whole UTC calendar month. Emit this instead of duplicating inferred effective dates or a separate period.
fixed_filing={"at":"ISO UTC cutoff","endpoint":"inclusive" or "exclusive"} when the contract gives an exact receipt cutoff.
Use this instead of a separate rolling filing_days operator. If both relative days and an exact timestamp appear, preserve
the exact timestamp; deterministic validation checks their consistency against the fixed service period.
record_integrity=["source_identifier","recorded_timestamp","content_hash","missing_unknown","no_customer_telemetry", "filing_timestamp"]
for the requirements explicitly stated by this span. Different blocks may contribute.
remedy="noncash_service_credit" if a service credit is noncash but there is no explicit future invoice commitment.
denial_policy list of "accept_correct","cure_missing","escalate_unsupported","no_automatic_appeal", "synthetic_only" only
as supported by the clause; these are reviewed local simulated claim controls, never permission to transmit.
For a fixed month of N elapsed minutes, the explicit formula 100 * (N - unavailable minutes) / N is supported as
interval_measurement=["availability_ratio"]. A zero-credit equality or above-threshold sentence is boundary="strict_below".
Do not type authoritative account-scoped aggregate status records as resource_intervals. The explicit fixed period
and scope can coexist with vendor or agreement identity when a source block contains more than one effect.
